benchmark_prediction_latency: benchmark prediction latency for various scikit-learn regressors in atomic and bulk mode
benchmark_estimator_runtimes: benchmark estimator runtimes for atomic and bulk prediction on test data
generate_regression_dataset: generate a regression dataset with configurable training, testing, and feature counts
measure_feature_influence: measure the influence of number of features on prediction time for an estimator
benchmark_prediction_throughputs: benchmark prediction throughput in predictions per second for different estimators
